line: Lenovo Yoga 9i 2-in-1 Aura Edition (14", Gen 10, Lunar Lake)
config_name: Yoga 9i 2-in-1 Aura Edition 14" — Core Ultra 7 258V, 16GB LPDDR5x, 1TB SSD, 2.8K OLED 120Hz touch

specs.display_type: OLED touch, glossy, HDR, rotating soundbar hinge
specs.speakers: Bowers & Wilkins rotating soundbar (2 woofers + 2 tweeters)
specs.keyboard_notes: Backlit chiclet, glass trackpad; Yoga Pen included (MPP 2.0, charges in chassis)

battery.notes: 70Wh, Lunar Lake efficiency; ~11-14h light web/video @150 nits. Big fix vs Gen 9 Meteor Lake battery complaint.

price.notes: Gen 10 Lunar Lake Aura tiers no longer at Best Buy CA (only Gen 11 Ultra 7 355 remains, SKU 19784270); lenovo.com/ca PDP is a JS shell — price estimated from CA launch pricing pattern.

reviews.quote: High-quality & stable case, improved battery life, good system performance, OLED with high 4K resolution, Thunderbolt 4 & Wi-Fi 7, stylus attaches to case magnetically. Cons: RAM can't be upgraded, PWM flickering, OLED only at 60 Hz and without color profiles, neither HDMI nor an SD card reader. ("The high-end convertible suffers due to weak 4K OLED" — NBC review of the Yoga 9 14 2-in-1 Gen 10 Lunar Lake.)

praises: Rotating soundbar hinge speakers are the best-sounding laptop speakers in this class — bass you can actually feel in tablet mode
2.8K OLED at 120Hz with inky blacks; video and photo editing look superb
Active pen included in the box (charges in the chassis slot), unlike the Yoga 7i line
1.32 kg machined-aluminium build feels genuinely flagship-thin and light
Lunar Lake battery life is a huge step up from the Meteor Lake Gen 9 — easily a full workday of light use
complaints: OLED moire/graininess on small black-on-white text is visible to sensitive users (confirmed by Notebookcheck)
USB-C-only ports (2x TB4) — dongle life for USB-A/HDMI without a dock
Glossy OLED reflects overhead lights outdoors
Soldered RAM and SSD — nothing upgradeable after purchase
Fan noise and performance drop under sustained load; not a creator workhorse despite the screen

design_philosophy: Lenovo's Yoga 9i is the convertible flagship: a machined-aluminium 360° 2-in-1 whose signature is the rotating soundbar hinge that keeps Bowers & Wilkins speakers aimed at you in every mode. The Aura Edition generation leans into thinness, Copilot+ AI silicon, and pen-first creativity — trading ports and upgradability for a 1.32 kg premium package. This 16GB/1TB Lunar Lake tier is the volume CA configuration and the battery-efficiency sweet spot of the line.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the Yoga 9 14 2-in-1 G10 Aura Edition (89%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Ratings inferred from generation-adjacent pro anchor (NBC 90.5% on Gen 9 14IMH9, same chassis family) plus BBY user data on the Gen 11 sibling (4.54 stars / 50 reviews); Lunar Lake deltas vs Gen 9 anchor: battery +1.5 (Meteor Lake was the line's weak point), ai_ml +1 (47 TOPS NPU), gaming +0 (Arc 140V ~= Arc 8-core here), thermals +0.5 (passable-cooling 17W chip). Moire keeps screen_quality at 8.8 not 9.3. Image URL is the Gen 11 sibling photo (same chassis). NBC/RTINGS review of the IMI9/IML9 Aura gen itself could not be located (documented in SHARED-yoga9i.md).
